_doc: Read by tools/patch_hunt_annexes.py (install step huntannexes) and tools/audit_hunts.py. One row per annex of a base hunt (server/README.md 'Hunt annexes (O337)'): id = the plan in tools/areaplan/annexes/, name = the hunt's sign monster, hunt = its id in tools/hall_hunts.csv, portal = the tile of the hunt where the forcefield goes, dest = the annex's arrival (tools/hunt_annexes_test.py compiles the plan and checks it), back = where the annex's exit portal leads (the plan's exit.to).
